supersedes_only: The runtime-cost estimator used to order the already frozen 11-state queue in parallel_execution_plan_v1_2_1.json. Scientific experiment IDs, seeds, initializations, configs, checkpoint selection and analysis semantics are unchanged.

resource_envelope.process_model: one independent single-GPU child per slot

allowed_pre_science_measurements: steady-state wall seconds per optimizer step after subtracting checkpoint save/load time
validation forward end-to-end examples per second with labels/metrics unopened

forecast_contract.checkpoint_event_upper_bound_definition: floor(35820/250) periodic latest writes + 30 epoch-end latest writes + at most 30 selected-checkpoint writes
forecast_contract.purpose: Scheduling only. Forecast values are never model-selection evidence and do not change scientific training.

priority_freeze_algorithm.name: deterministic_longest_processing_time_first
priority_freeze_algorithm.state_cost: estimated_full_run_seconds_upper_bound from the sealed v1.2.2 profile qualification
priority_freeze_algorithm.initial_dispatch: assign first six states to K1/GPU0, K1/GPU1, K2/GPU0, K2/GPU1, K3/GPU0, K3/GPU1 in that order
priority_freeze_algorithm.continuation_dispatch: next queued state goes to the first qualified physical slot that becomes free; simultaneous-free ties use fixed slot order

placement_and_recovery.checkpoint_scientific_identity: stable logical experiment lane independent of physical Kaggle account/GPU
placement_and_recovery.cross_slot_resume: authorized after exact durable-checkpoint identity/hash verification on another qualified T4
